servers.name: Nomad Arcade
servers.description:
Nomad Arcade is a Hytale playground built around one idea: get your hands on a working rigid-body physics system and see what it can do on this engine.

Knock pins around in the bowling alley, take a boat out on the lake, or spend time in the two sandbox areas with the physics gun and gravity gun. The server exists so we can test shove, hold, pull, and collision while we sketch the first minigames on top of that foundation. Nothing here is meant to be finished content; it's a live workshop where the physics and the play spaces grow together.

This is the future home of our minigames. Come play while we build them.
